info.description: Generated from packages/domain by `bun run domain:openapi`. Do not edit by hand. Unknown fields and unknown values of open enums/unions must be ignored by clients (see packages/domain/README.md).

bearer.description: Native access token or personal access token.

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match does not match the current version.

workspace_id.description: The only workspace the token can act on.

prefix.description: First characters of the token, shown to tell tokens apart.

AccessToken.description: Personal access token metadata. The secret is only returned once, on create.

AccessTokenId.description: Opaque id of a personal access token. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

due_raw.description: Due phrase as spoken, if any.

ActionItemId.description: Opaque id of a action item. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

model.description: Pinned model id requested (never a `-latest` alias).

model_version.description: Model version the provider reported back.

AiCallId.description: Opaque id of a model call ledger entry. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

message.description: Human-readable message, safe to show to the user.

ApiError.description: The only error body shape the API returns.

ArtifactId.description: Opaque id of a stage artifact. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

part_index.description: Order of audio parts within the recording (0-based).

Asset.description: A file of a recording. Fetch the bytes from `/assets/{asset_id}/content`.

AssetId.description: Opaque id of a asset (audio part, PDF or image). New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

AuthSessionId.description: Opaque id of a login session (device). New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

BatchEventCandidatesRequest.description: Accept or dismiss many suggestions at once.

BlockId.description: Opaque id of a document block, unique within its document version. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

CalendarSuggestedEvent.description: New event candidates are waiting in the suggestion inbox.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading, e.g. the topic name.

job.description: Processing job, unless the upload was a duplicate.

deduplicated.description: The audio matched an existing recording in the workspace (by sha256).

audio_ms.description: Audio that would be transcribed (0 for `document` mode).

expires_at.description: Omit or null for no expiry.

CreateDocumentVersionRequest.description: A user edit. Send the version it was based on in `If-Match`; the server renders Markdown.

sort_key.description: Omit to append after the last sibling.

color.description: Design-token colour name (e.g. `blue`), never a raw colour value.

recording_id.description: Add the files to this recording instead of creating one.

recording.description: Hints for the new recording. Not allowed with `recording_id`.

recorded_at.description: When recording started, from the client clock. Omit if unknown: the server falls back to media metadata, then upload time, and records which in `recorded_at_source`.

CreateWorkspaceRequest.description: Creates a team workspace owned by the caller. Personal workspaces are created automatically.

secret.description: The token itself. Shown only in this response.

url.description: Public URL with the token. Shown only in this response.

method.description: `parser`: the deterministic Korean date parser resolved it.

workspace_id.description: Workspace the session is acting in; starts as the user's personal workspace.

current.description: This is the session making the request.

Device.description: A signed-in browser or app (one auth session).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

user_edited.description: A user edited the document (incl. the P1 bridge Markdown).

DocumentBlock.description: A verified document block. Open union on `type`: render unknown types as nothing.

DocumentBody.description: Structured document. Markdown/HTML are rendered from this, never the other way round.

DocumentId.description: Opaque id of a document. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

key.description: Section key from the template, e.g. `summary`.

title.description: Display title; templates set it, users may rename it later.

base_version.description: Version this one was edited from; null for generated ones.

body.description: Null only for `legacy-markdown` versions, which have Markdown alone.

DocumentVersionId.description: Opaque id of a document version. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

base_version.description: Version this one was edited from; null for generated ones.

DocumentWithVersion.description: A document with its current version. The response `ETag` is the version.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error code. Open enum: fall back to the HTTP status for codes you do not know.

start_at.description: UTC. For all-day events: local midnight in `tz`, converted to UTC.

end_at.description: UTC, exclusive. For all-day events: local midnight after the last day.

tz.description: Zone the event was resolved in (the user's zone at extraction time).

raw_expression.description: Date phrase as spoken, e.g. `다음 주 화요일 수업 전까지`.

EventCandidateId.description: Opaque id of a calendar event candidate. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

EventId.description: Monotonic event id (`job_events.id`). Opaque: echo it back in `Last-Event-ID`.

quote.description: Verbatim phrase the item was extracted from, if the model gave one.

Evidence.description: Why an extracted item exists: the source ranges and the quoted phrase.

sort_key.description: Fractional index; siblings sort by this byte-wise.

FolderId.description: Opaque id of a folder. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading, e.g. the topic name.
Optional sub-heading, e.g. the topic name.

workspace_id.description: Workspace whose events this integration syncs.

Integration.description: A connected external account. OAuth tokens never leave the server.

IntegrationId.description: Opaque id of a integration. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

JobDetail.description: A job with its stage timeline and model calls (AI_HARNESS §9).

JobId.description: Opaque id of a job. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

progress.description: Fraction of the whole job, when known.

JobProgressEvent.description: A stage started, advanced or finished.

JobUpdatedEvent.description: The job row changed state (queued, running, succeeded, failed, canceled).

heading.description: Optional sub-heading, e.g. the topic name.

LocalDate.description: Calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD` in a stated time zone (not UTC).

LocalTime.description: Wall-clock time `HH:MM` (24h) in a stated time zone.

timezone.description: Used to resolve relative dates and to show times. Default `Asia/Seoul`.

MembershipRole.description: Workspace role. Separate from the system role on the user.

MicroUsd.description: Money in millionths of a US dollar.

MyWorkspace.description: A workspace the caller belongs to, with the caller's role.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

domain.description: When set, classify keeps it and only suggests title and folder.

NewRecordingFields.description: User hints for the recording an upload creates. Everything else is classified.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading, e.g. the topic name.

QuestionId.description: Opaque id of a question. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

QuestionKind.description: `recall`: active-recall card (lectures). `issue`: key issue Q&A (meetings). `discussion`: open prompt.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading, e.g. the topic name.

RecordedAtSource.description: Where `recorded_at` came from: the client, media metadata (`creation_time`), or the upload time as a last resort.

template_id.description: Template for new documents; null lets classify decide.

recorded_at.description: When recording started. Relative dates in events are resolved against it.

active_job.description: The queued or running job, if any.

RecordingDomain.description: What kind of spoken session the recording is.

RecordingId.description: Opaque id of a recording. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

template_id.description: Template for new documents; null lets classify decide.

recorded_at.description: When recording started. Relative dates in events are resolved against it.

RecordingListItem.description: A recording as shown in library lists.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

RecordingStatus.description: User-facing processing state of a recording.

source.description: `ai` when the classify stage attached the tag.

confidence.description: Classifier confidence for `ai` tags, else null.

RecordingUpdatedEvent.description: Any change to the recording row, including status.

RecordingVisibility.description: `private`: creator only. `workspace`: every member. Public access goes through share links.

mode.description: `document`: classify/structure onward, no re-transcription. `full`: every stage, transcription included.

template_id.description: Template for the new document; default is the recording's.

SearchHit.description: Open union on `kind`: skip unknown kinds.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

ServerEvent.description: One SSE message. Open union on `type`: ignore unknown types.

ShareLink.description: A share link. The URL with its token is only returned once, on create.

ShareLinkId.description: Opaque id of a share link. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

ShareScope.description: What a share link exposes besides the document (ARCHITECTURE §10). New flags default to false.

SnippetPart.description: A run of snippet text; `highlight` marks matched text. Concatenate the runs to get the snippet.

page.description: 1-based page number in that PDF asset.

SourceRef.description: A verified pointer to a transcript segment range (original-audio time) or a PDF page. Open union: skip unknown `kind`s.

display_name.description: User-given name; shown instead of the label.

SpeakerId.description: Opaque id of a speaker. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

StageRunId.description: Opaque id of a stage run. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

return_to.description: App path to return to after consent, e.g. `/settings/integrations`.

authorization_url.description: Send the browser here to grant `calendar.app.created`.

SystemRole.description: Operator role on the whole service (today's `users.role`).

color.description: Design-token colour name (e.g. `blue`), never a raw colour value.

TagId.description: Opaque id of a tag. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

TemplateId.description: Template slug, e.g. `lecture`, `meeting`, `legacy-markdown`. Paired with an integer template version.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading, e.g. the topic name.

Timestamp.description: ISO-8601 date-time in UTC with a `Z` suffix, e.g. `2026-10-19T05:30:00.000Z`. Offsets are rejected; the user's zone lives in `timezone` fields.

segments.description: Every segment, ordered by `idx`. Not paginated.

Transcript.description: The whole transcript of a recording. Times are original-audio ms.

TranscriptGap.description: Original-audio time range with no transcript.

TranscriptReadyEvent.description: The merged transcript is published; documents may still be in progress.

idx.description: Position in the transcript; `#idx` in prompts and SourceRefs.

start_ms.description: Original-audio time (never cut-audio or chunk time).

end_ms.description: Original-audio time (never cut-audio or chunk time).

source_chunk.description: Index of the chunk that produced the segment.

TranscriptSegment.description: Merged transcript segment. Times are original-audio ms (AI_HARNESS §3.2 invariant). Keyed by (recording_id, idx).

UpdateEventCandidateRequest.description: Edit or decide one suggestion. `synced` is set by the server only.

color.description: Design-token colour name (e.g. `blue`), never a raw colour value.

sha256.description: Whole-file digest; checked on complete when given.

first_part.description: Number of this file's first part.

sha256.description: Whole-file digest; checked on complete when given.

UploadId.description: Opaque id of a resumable upload session. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

sha256.description: Digest of the bytes the server stored, for the client to compare.

recording_id.description: Target recording; set at create or on complete.

part_size.description: Bytes per part; a file's last part may be shorter.

received_parts.description: Part numbers stored so far, ascending.

UsageLedger.description: Per-workspace usage for one month, used to enforce quotas.

UsageLedgerId.description: Opaque id of a usage ledger row. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

UserId.description: Opaque id of a user. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

VerifyFlag.description: Verifier flags. Open enum: new flags may be added.

plan.description: Plan slug set by an operator (no billing yet, ROADMAP D10), e.g. `free`.

WorkspaceId.description: Opaque id of a workspace. New rows use UUIDv7; rows migrated from v1 keep their old id. Never parse it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

calendar_auto_add.description: Auto-register explicit-date events at or above `min_confidence` (ARCHITECTURE §11). Off when absent.

WorkspaceSettings.description: Workspace settings. Every field is optional; the server applies defaults.
